title: MYSU Celebrates 5th Foundation Day; New Executive Council for 2026–2028 Takes Oath
summary: MYSU celebrated its 5th Foundation Day at Takyel, Imphal, as its newly elected 21-member Executive Council for 2026–2028 took the oath of office.
body:
Imphal, November 23, 2026: The Manipur Youth & Students’ Union (MYSU) celebrated its 5th Foundation Day-cum-Oath-Taking Ceremony on Sunday, November 22, at The Government Ideal Blind School, Takyel, Imphal, with its newly elected 21-member General Headquarters (GHQ) Executive Council formally assuming office for the 2026–2028 tenure.

The new council was elected during MYSU’s 2nd General Assembly Election, the results of which were officially declared on November 15, 2026, by Returning Officer Wahengbam Shanta Meitei.

The programme commenced at 10:30 a.m. with the arrival of the presidium members and invited guests. The ceremony featured the traditional presentation of Lengyan Phi to the dignitaries, the lighting of the ceremonial lamp and a moment of silence in honour of freedom fighters and patriots.

Koijam Pritam Singh, General Secretary (Administration) of MYSU, delivered the welcome address, while newly elected President Pukhrimayum Sadam presented the keynote address.

During the programme, representatives of various civil society organisations (CSOs), media representatives and special invitees were felicitated with gifts in recognition of their presence and participation. The ceremony was anchored by Singamayum Samina Sheikh of Mami TV and Mirror Lilong.

Dignitaries on the Presidium

The event was attended by several distinguished personalities who served as presidium members, including:

Wahengbam Tanu Chanu – Founder President, MYSU GHQ

Dr. Chinglen Meisnam – Professor and Head, Department of South East Asian Studies, Manipur University

Wahengbam Shanta Meitei – President, FIDM-cum-Advisor, MYSU

Th. Manihar – Founder President, FOCs

Mangibala Huirem – Headmistress, The Government Ideal Blind School, Takyel, Imphal

Miraj Shah Korimayum – Managing Director, North East New TV

Sharungbam Arunkumar Singh – Project Director, Right Living Drug De-Addiction-cum-Advisor, MYSU

MYSU GHQ Executive Council for 2026–2028

The newly elected 21-member Executive Council comprises the following office bearers and executive members:

Vice President: Md Irfan Khan

Finance Secretary: Chingkham Abungo Singh

Publicity Secretary: Mutum Jeena

Assistant Publicity Secretary: Naorem Somi Devi

Organisation Secretary: Mission Moirangthem

Women Affairs Secretary: Thongam Mangal Lembi

Drug Affairs Secretary: Md Yunish Shah

Game and Sports Secretary: Mohammad Mukhtar

Auditor General: Md Kabir Ahmed

Office Secretary: Md Imliyas

Executive Members

Khaidem Manithoi Singh

Md Rahish

Mayangmayum Sakinuddin

Anish Ali

Korimayum Sahli

Md Harish

With the new council formally taking charge, MYSU begins its 2026–2028 tenure under the leadership of President Pukhrimayum Sadam. The foundation day celebration also marked an occasion for the organisation to recognise its journey and bring together members, invited dignitaries, civil society representatives and media personnel.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
